info.title: PuzzleQuest API
info.description:
PuzzleQuest's API, for its web pages and for apps.

Sign in with `POST /sessions`. A browser keeps the session in a cookie; an app asks for its token (`"client": "native"`) and sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A request that changes something and is sent with the cookie must come from this site.

Lists come a page at a time: `?limit=` (default 50, at most 200) and `?after=`, the `next` value of the page before.

Clients follow a quest as it happens over the live-update websocket, `/api/v1/updates`. Anyone may connect. A client sends a `LiveUpdateSubscription` naming the quest; the server answers with its connection's ID, then sends a `LiveUpdate` for each change to that quest, naming the puzzle concerned where there is one. A client sends its connection's ID as `connectionId` with its own actions, so their updates aren't sent back to it. Both messages are described under the schemas. Updates can be missed, so a client should fetch the quest's state again each time it connects. Starting and resetting a quest send no update.

Errors are problem details (RFC 9457), sent as `application/problem+json`. Act on their `type`, one of:

| Type | Status | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/problems/invalid-request` | 400 | The request's parameters or body are missing, malformed, or have values that aren't allowed. The errors member lists each problem, with where it is, such as body.email. |
| `/problems/sign-in-required` | 401 | The request needs a signed-in user, and has no session, or one that has ended. |
| `/problems/sign-in-failed` | 401 | The user name and password don't match an account. Which of them is wrong isn't said. |
| `/problems/forbidden` | 403 | The signed-in user isn't allowed to do this. |
| `/problems/cross-site-request` | 403 | A request that changes something was sent with this site's cookie from a page on another site. Send it from this site, or with a Bearer token. |
| `/problems/not-found` | 404 | There is no such resource, or the signed-in user may not know about it. |
| `/problems/already-exists` | 409 | Something with that name, email address, or join code already exists, or the user is already a member of the team. |
| `/problems/email-not-verified` | 409 | The user hasn't verified their email address, so nothing can be sent to it that depends on it, such as a password reset link. |
| `/problems/incorrect-password` | 422 | The current password given isn't the user's password. |
| `/problems/password-not-allowed` | 422 | The new password doesn't meet the password policy, such as its length, or is the same as the current one. |
| `/problems/wrong-join-code` | 422 | The join code isn't the team's. |
| `/problems/invalid-link` | 422 | The token from a password reset or email verification link isn't valid: it is malformed, already used, or expired. |
| `/problems/in-use` | 409 | It can't be deleted while something uses it, such as a puzzle a quest includes. The detail says what uses it. |
| `/problems/invalid-upload` | 400 | The upload is missing a field, sends its fields in the wrong order, or is a kind of file that isn't accepted. |
| `/problems/upload-too-large` | 413 | The uploaded file is larger than allowed. |
| `/problems/invalid-quest` | 422 | The quest is assigned to a user or team that doesn't exist, or lists a puzzle that doesn't exist or appears twice. |
| `/problems/wrong-state` | 409 | The quest or puzzle isn't in a state that allows this: for example, the quest has already started, isn't paused, or is completed, or the puzzle hasn't been reached or solved. The detail says which. |
| `/problems/quest-paused` | 409 | The puzzle master has paused the quest; the players can't act until it resumes. |
| `/problems/try-again` | 409 | Someone else changed the quest at the same moment, several times over. Try again. |
| `/problems/wrong-activation-code` | 422 | The activation code, typed or scanned, isn't the puzzle's. |
| `/problems/wrong-answer` | 422 | The guess isn't the puzzle's solution. |
| `/problems/no-recipients` | 409 | Nobody the quest is assigned to has a phone number and accepts text messages. |
| `/problems/messaging-failed` | 502 | The text messaging service refused or failed to send a message. The details are logged. |
| `/problems/unreadable-qr-code` | 422 | No QR code could be read from the scanned image; try again, closer or with more light, or type the code. |
| `/problems/no-more-hints` | 409 | Every one of the puzzle's hints has been revealed. |
| `/problems/too-many-requests` | 429 | Too many attempts in a short time. The RateLimit and RateLimit-Policy headers say when to try again. |
| `/problems/unexpected` | 500 | Something went wrong on the server. The details are logged, not sent. |
| `about:blank` | 4xx | Any other HTTP error, such as a body too large to read; the title is the status's. |

post.description: Starts a session. A browser ("web", the default) gets it as a cookie; an app ("native") gets its token in the response.

delete.description: Ends the session the request presents, from its cookie or Bearer token. Signing out when not signed in does nothing.

post.summary: Sign up, or create a user
post.description: Anyone may sign up, as a player. An administrator creating a user may also choose its authorization level. A verification email is sent to the address.

409.description: /problems/already-exists: Already exists.

patch.description: Changes the fields given. A new email address must be verified again, and a verification email is sent to it. Only an administrator may change an authorization level, which signs the user out everywhere.

409.description: /problems/already-exists: Already exists.

delete.description: Deletes the user, ends their sessions, and removes them from their teams. Quests assigned to them stay, assigned to a deleted user.

put.description: Needs the current password, so only the user may do it. The user stays signed in on this device, and is signed out everywhere else.

post.summary: Email a user a password reset link
post.description: For an administrator helping a user who can't sign in. The link goes to the user's verified email address.

409.description: /problems/email-not-verified: Email address not verified.

post.summary: Email a user a new verification link
Ask for a password reset link
post.description: Emails a reset link to the account with this user name or email address, if it has a verified address. The response is the same whether or not there is such an account, so it doesn't say which accounts exist.
Sets a new password with the token from a reset link, and signs the user out everywhere.

422.description: /problems/invalid-link: Link invalid or expired. /problems/password-not-allowed: Password not allowed.

post.description: With the token from a verification link.

post.description: Stores an image, audio, or video file for a puzzle, named after the puzzle, replacing any file of the same name. Give the returned path as the puzzle's text.

puzzleName.description: The puzzle the file is for; the file is named after it.

fileExtension.description: The file's extension, which says what kind of file it is: one of avif, bmp, gif, jpeg, jpg, png, webp, aac, flac, m4a, mp3, oga, ogg, opus, wav, m4v, mov, mp4, ogv, webm.

binary.description: The file, at most 100 MB; sent after the other fields.

post.description: Assigns it to a user or team, with its puzzles in order; each puzzle gets an activation code unless one is given.

409.description: /problems/already-exists: Already exists.

get.description: An administrator sees all of it. A player sees a quest assigned to them or their team once it has started, with only the puzzles they have reached; any other quest is not found.

patch.description: Changes the fields given. Once the quest has started, the puzzles the players have reached stay in place at the start of the list; a completed quest's puzzles can't change until it is reset. Progress changes only through the actions.

409.description: /problems/wrong-state: Not possible now. /problems/try-again: Changed at the same time.

post.description: Makes its first puzzle available to activate. A player's phone call to the quest's number does the same.

409.description: /problems/wrong-state: Not possible now. /problems/try-again: Changed at the same time.

post.description: Returns it to not started, clearing the players' progress and pauses. The event log keeps what happened.

409.description: /problems/wrong-state: Not possible now. /problems/try-again: Changed at the same time.

post.description: Stops its clocks; the players can't activate, guess, or reveal hints until it resumes, and the paused time doesn't count.

post.summary: Skip a puzzle for the players
post.description: Completes a puzzle the players have reached, with no penalty; they see its solution, and the next puzzle becomes available. Allowed while the quest is paused.

409.description: /problems/wrong-state: Not possible now. /problems/try-again: Changed at the same time.

post.description: Returns a completed puzzle to in progress, so the players solve it again, and every later puzzle to not reached. For a puzzle that accepted a wrong answer: pause the quest, correct the puzzle, reset it here, and resume. Allowed while the quest is paused.

409.description: /problems/wrong-state: Not possible now. /problems/try-again: Changed at the same time.

get.description: The quest's event log, oldest first. It keeps names as they were at the time, and survives resetting the quest.

post.description: Texts the message to the quest's players who accept text messages, a few seconds apart, as carriers require. With an expected response, the quest waits for that reply and texts the confirmation back when it arrives.

expectedResponse.description: A reply for the quest to wait for; letter case doesn't matter.

responseConfirmation.description: What is texted back when the reply arrives.

409.description: /problems/wrong-state: Not possible now. /problems/no-recipients: Nobody to text.

get.summary: See a puzzle as its players do
get.description: For a puzzle the players have reached: what it asks, once activated, the hints revealed, what the next hint would cost, and the solution, once solved. A puzzle not yet reached is not found, even by an administrator, who can see the whole quest with getQuest. Players never learn how many puzzles a quest has.

post.description: Starts the puzzle the players have found, with its activation code: typed, as JSON, or scanned, as a multipart camera frame of its QR code. Failed attempts are limited for each player.

activationCode.description: The code, typed, in any letter case; or scan its QR code instead.

width.description: The scanned frame's width, in pixels.

height.description: The scanned frame's height, in pixels.

image.description: The frame's raw RGBA pixels, four bytes each, at most 20 MB.

409.description: /problems/wrong-state: Not possible now. /problems/quest-paused: Quest paused. /problems/try-again: Changed at the same time.

422.description: /problems/wrong-activation-code: Wrong activation code. /problems/unreadable-qr-code: QR code not readable.

post.description: A guess is right if it contains each of the solution's keywords; letter case, spacing, and punctuation don't matter. Wrong guesses are limited for each player.

connectionId.description: The page's live-update connection, which isn't sent the update about this action.

200.description: The guess is right; the puzzle is solved.

409.description: /problems/wrong-state: Not possible now. /problems/quest-paused: Quest paused. /problems/try-again: Changed at the same time.

post.description: Each hint adds its time penalty to the players' score. The answer says whether the next hint gives the solution away, so a page can warn first.

connectionId.description: The page's live-update connection, which isn't sent the update about this action.

409.description: /problems/wrong-state: Not possible now. /problems/quest-paused: Quest paused. /problems/try-again: Changed at the same time. /problems/no-more-hints: No more hints.

get.description: What anyone may see of a quest: its progress and the puzzles its players have reached. How many puzzles it has is never shown. A quest that hasn't started shows its name and status, with no puzzles.
What anyone may see of a puzzle once its players have activated it: what it asks, the hints revealed, and the solution, once solved. A puzzle not yet activated is not found.

sms.description: True if the user accepts text messages.

type.description: 0 for text, 1 for an image, 2 for audio, 3 for video.

name.description: Missing if the user or team has been deleted.
